title: Has anyone been to this big blue mansion?
content: I recently noticed I’ve had recurring dreams in this mansion since I was a child and I’ve been trying to map it out. It’s unique to my other dream locations as I’m usually fully aware of where I am even if it looks completely different to my reality (ie im in my childhood home or a version of my university). The entrance of the mansion is a giant room with a grand staircase leading up to an exposed second floor wrapped by a balcony. The stair case has no railings and the entire room (stairs, floor, walls, and ceiling) is covered in a deep blue velvet fabric. I’m always viewing myself from the third person in this room and am wearing a long white underdress with puffy long sleeves. Once you enter any of the rooms on the second floor the style changes to an old wooden house with all wooden furniture. All the upstairs rooms seem to be connected by odd hallways and mini staircases. The basement is a big dark cement room with wooden shelves full of random items lining the walls. Lots of clutter on tables around the room too. Once I get to this location I’m usually trying to hide from someone. I usually get chased to an abandoned looking barn on the property. None of the walls are finished and there’s insulation hanging out everywhere. The rooms in this barn seem to go on forever. The house sits on a big steep hill. In the front there lots of greenery and rocks looking like your in a forest. Around the back there’s a big cliff with a hedge maze sitting at the bottom. I’m always dreaming of beating chased when I get to the maze too. That’s about all I’ve been able to remember so far. Has anyone been to this property or any of the specific locations on it? I’ve been dreaming about this place my whole life and it always starts of in the blue room, followed by the wooden rooms, after that I go different places based on what kind on dream I’m having.
